explanation_ka:
**წარსული განგრძობითი დრო (Past Continuous)** - წარსულში რაღაც მიმდინარეობდა.

**როგორ ვაშენებთ:**
• **was/were + ზმნა-ing**
• **I/he/she/it** → **was** + ზმნა-ing
• **you/we/they** → **were** + ზმნა-ing
• **მაგ:** I **was** **reading** = ვკითხულობდი

**როდის ვიყენებთ:**
• **წარსულში კონკრეტულ დროს რაღაც ხდებოდა**
  - **მაგ:** At 5 PM, I **was** watching TV = 5 საათზე ტელევიზორს ვუყურებდი
• **ერთი მოქმედება მეორეს წყვეტს (when)**
  - **მაგ:** I **was** sleeping **when** the phone **rang**
• **ორი მოქმედება ერთდროულად (while)**
  - **მაგ:** **While** she **was** cooking, he **was** cleaning

**ნეგატივი და კითხვა:**
• **უარყოფა:** wasn't/weren't + ზმნა-ing
• **კითხვა:** Was/Were + სუბიექტი + ზმნა-ing?

**გახსოვდეთ:** **when** = Past Simple, **while** = Past Continuous

examples.en: I was studying when you called me.
They were playing football at 5 PM yesterday.
examples.ka: ისინი გუშინ საღამოს 5 საათზე ფეხბურთს თამაშობდნენ.

examples.en: She wasn't listening to the teacher.
Were you sleeping when I arrived?
While I was reading, my brother was watching TV.
examples.ka: სანამ მე ვკითხულობდი, ჩემი ძმა ტელევიზორს უყურებდა.

common_mistakes_ka: ხშირი შეცდომები: 1) was/were-ს არასწორი გამოყენება — 'I were reading' არასწორია, სწორია 'I was reading'. 2) -ing სუფიქსის დავიწყება — 'I was read' არასწორია. 3) Past Simple-თან აღრევა — 'I was studied' არასწორია, სწორია 'I was studying'. 4) When/While-ს არასწორი გამოყენება — when ჩვეულებრივ Past Simple-თან გამოიყენება, while კი Past Continuous-თან.

exercises.question: I ___ (watch) TV when the lights went out.
They ___ (not/play) outside because it was raining.
Which sentence is correct?
___ you ___ (sleep) at midnight?
While he ___ (drive), it started to snow.
When do we use Past Continuous?
options: For completed actions in the past
For actions in progress at a specific time in the past
exercises.answer: For actions in progress at a specific time in the past

exercises.question: We ___ (sit) in the park when it began to rain.
She ___ (not/listen) to music, she ___ (read) a book.
Choose the correct form: 'At 3 PM yesterday, I ___ lunch.'
The children ___ (run) in the garden while their parents ___ (talk).
I ___ (study) for my exam all afternoon yesterday.
What ___ you ___ at 8 o'clock last night?
The phone rang while I ___ (take) a shower.
Which is correct?
options: I were walking when I saw him.
I was walking when I saw him.
I was walk when I saw him.
I walking when I saw him.
exercises.answer: I was walking when I saw him.

exercises.question: They ___ (not/work) yesterday at this time.
When we use 'while' with Past Continuous, it shows:
options: Two actions happening at the same time
exercises.answer: Two actions happening at the same time

exercises.question: ___ the baby ___ (cry) when you arrived?
She ___ (clean) the house all morning.
რომელია სწორი?
At this time last week, I ___ (fly) to London.
It ___ (snow) heavily when we left home.
Choose the right pattern for interruption:
options: I was eating when he calls.
I was eating when he called.
I ate when he was calling.
exercises.answer: I was eating when he called.

exercises.question: The students ___ (not/pay) attention during the lesson.
While mom ___ (cook), dad ___ (help) me with homework.
When do we typically use Past Continuous with 'while'?
options: For actions that happened one after another
For two actions happening at the same time
exercises.answer: For two actions happening at the same time
